  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Planner misinterprets the conflicting search results or assumes the wrong director based on partial data, the instructions sent to the WebSurfer will be flawed.

      description: Repeatedly instructing the WebSurfer to visit the same failing URLs without adjusting the strategy (e.g., due to timeout errors) creates a loop of failed attempts.

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will continue to report timeouts, preventing progress toward the final answer.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner fails to recognize that direct URL navigation is failing and does not switch to search-based discovery, the correct director cannot be found.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The correct director (Brad Silberling) remains unverified because the WebSurfer cannot access the primary source (IMDb) via direct links.
